Toolchains.Title: Build runners
Settings.Section.ToolchainSetup.Title: Build runners
Settings.Section.ToolchainSetup.Descript: Certify build providers on an Office image before project use.
Toolchains.Intro: Certify a business's build provider on an Office image before a project can use it. Deployment administrator access is required.
Toolchains.NoProvider: No enabled, built provider is installed for this business. Review and install its published package first.
Toolchains.NoOffice: No connected Office currently offers a ready runtime image for toolchain builds.
Toolchains.ReviewHelp: Certification runs each declared fixture twice on the selected image. Installation or a project decision alone does not certify capacity. All checks must pass before project selection.
Toolchains.Reviewed: I reviewed this provider and Office image and want to run certification tests.
Toolchains.Queued: Certification was scheduled. Build capacity remains unavailable until the real fixture checks pass. Refresh to see the result.

LanguageSettings.Intro: Choose the language the workspace is shown in and the time zone used for dates and times. Agents write their updates, plans, and deliverables for you in the same language.
_LanguageSettings.FollowDevice: {language} is the native name of the language currently detected from the device, e.g. 'Follow device (Deutsch)'.
LanguageSettings.LanguageHelp: Saved to your account when you are signed in, so it follows you to other devices.
_LanguageSettings.TimeZonePreview: {time} is the current date and time already formatted.
LanguageSettings.PersistenceUnavailable: Applied for this session. Browser storage is unavailable, so it may reset when you return unless you are signed in.
LanguageSettings.SaveFailed: The preference was applied here but could not be saved to your account. It will be retried the next time you change it.
